source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape/figure scene with an overhanging willow beside a riverbank, a scholar riding a water buffalo, a young attendant leading it, faint water and bank washes, bamboo and rocky ground in the foreground. Red seals and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: overhanging_willow_canopy
motifs.description: Large drooping willow canopy suspended across the upper-left and upper-center area, including the fine pendant leaf curtains and the diagonal dark branch structure, isolated from the trunk and figures below.
must_preserve: dense fine ink linework of hanging willow leaves
soft green-gray wash texture within the foliage
diagonal branch arcs and forked twigs
irregular feathered edges of the leaf curtains

motifs.name: gnarled_willow_trunk
motifs.description: Tall old willow trunk on the right side, rising from the bank and splitting into dark vertical masses, with bark scars, knots, and nearby hanging foliage but excluding red seals.
must_preserve: dark textured bark strokes and mottled ink patches
vertical trunk fissures and knot shapes
forked trunk silhouette
subtle washes around attached drooping willow strands

motifs.name: hazy_river_surface
motifs.description: Open river or lake surface occupying the left and middle background, with pale horizontal water lines and misty washes, kept free of figures and seals.
must_preserve: faint horizontal ripple lines
thin atmospheric wash layers
soft transitions between water and mist
nearly transparent shoreline hints

motifs.name: faint_left_reed_bank
motifs.description: Subtle vertical reed or bank forms along the far-left water edge, including pale ink washes and sparse upright strokes.
must_preserve: delicate vertical reed strokes
blurred wash mass at the left edge
low-contrast ink texture
soft misted edges merging into the water

motifs.name: scholar_riding_buffalo
motifs.description: Central lower group of an elderly scholar in pale robes seated on a dark water buffalo, with the small front figure, saddle cloth, horns, legs, and tail included as one reusable figure-and-animal motif.
must_preserve: scholar facial linework, beard, and dark hat with red accent
flowing robe contour lines and pale wash folds
buffalo curved horns, dark body wash, hooves, and tail
small seated/front figure details and harness lines
contrast between black buffalo wash and light clothing

motifs.name: young_attendant_with_rope
motifs.description: Walking young attendant at lower left-center, leaning forward and holding the lead rope or switch, isolated without the buffalo body.
must_preserve: small facial and hair-knot linework
folded robe outlines and light ocher-gray wash
bent walking posture and bare legs
thin lead rope or switch line extending from the hands
subtle ground contact strokes around the feet

motifs.name: right_bamboo_thicket
motifs.description: Foreground bamboo cluster in the lower-right corner, with overlapping leaves, thin stems, and dark ink accents along the bank, excluding nearby seals.
must_preserve: slender bamboo stems and nodes
pointed leaf clusters in layered ink lines
dark brush accents at the base
interlaced foliage silhouettes
light green-gray wash accents

motifs.name: tree_base_earthen_bank
motifs.description: Small sloping earthen mound at the base of the willow trunk, with dotted grass marks, pale wash, and dark edge strokes, isolated from seals and figures.
must_preserve: curved sandy mound contour
scattered black grass dots and small strokes
soft ocher-gray ground wash
dark textured shadow where trunk meets earth
irregular natural bank edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
